column1: # demo  verified_ticks  canonical_registered_state_fnv1a
# Regenerated 2026-08-14, for a snapshot-shape change with no simulation change behind it: the
# twiddle cooldown (vz.twiddleWait) became one per ship, so a registry scalar became a two-element
# array and the hashed buffer grew two bytes. Verified by registering only element [0] under its
# old name and size, every other change in the same commit kept: all three hashes came back at the
# previous line's values, so nothing in the new ship coverage or twiddle pacing moves the demos.
# Regenerated 2026-08-10, for a real simulation change: a trailing large sidekick fires from
# SIDEKICK_TRAIL_SHOT_Y below its position, and all three demos fly a Companion Ship Gerund in the
# left slot, so its shots start seven pixels lower and connect on different ticks. Verified to be
# that change alone by building with the constant at 0, every other edit kept: all three hashes came
# back at the previous line's values. Confirmed not to be a local config artifact: the three hashes
# below come back identically from a working directory with no opentyrian.cfg in it.
# Regenerated 2026-08-10, for a real simulation change: Shot Hitboxes defaults to Centered, which
# moves the point both shot loops collide a projectile from, so shots in the demos connect on
# different ticks. Confirmed to be the default and not a local config artifact: the three hashes
# below come back identically with no opentyrian.cfg present at all and with a full one whose only
# difference is the new key, so nothing else in a saved config is moving them.
# Regenerated 2026-08-07, for two snapshot-shape changes with no simulation change behind them:
#  - the Soul-of-Zinglon pillar render request (zinglonPillarActive/CX/Temp) became one per ship,
#    so three registry scalars became three two-element arrays. Verified by registering only
#    element [0] of each under its old name and size, every other change kept: all three hashes
#    and the layout hash came back identical to the previous line.
#  - JE_SingleEnemyType gained homeTarget (endless co-op homing). It lands in existing padding, so
#    sizeof and the layout hash do not move, but the fields after it shift a byte and demo 1's
#    hashed state moves with them. Verified by building with the field declared and never
#    assigned: demo 1 still hashes dbd7383e, so the shift alone accounts for it.
# Regenerated 2026-08-14, for a registered-value change with no simulation change behind it: an
# enemy's healthbar_max now holds the armor it spawned with instead of staying 0 until something
# damaged it, so every live slot carries a different byte from its first frame. Verified by building
# with enemy_note_full_armor made inert and the old first-hit assignment restored, every other edit
# in the commit kept: all three hashes came back at the previous line's values, so nothing in the
# new denominator, the boss-bar survey, or the script-event calls moves the demos. Confirmed not to
# be a local config artifact: the three hashes below come back identically from a working directory
# with no opentyrian.cfg in it. The snapshot shape is untouched: a build of the parent commit in a
# scratch worktree reports the same 311 items, 455190 bytes, and layout 5fb4f29d.
# Regenerated 2026-08-16, for a snapshot-shape change with no simulation change behind it:
# Chain Reaction now measures each queued pulse against the perks of the ship that made the kill,
# so the kill-site queue gained a parallel owner array (t2.chainPulseOwner) and the registry grew
# one 256-byte item. Verified by building with that single rollback_register line removed, every
# other edit in the commit kept: all three hashes and the layout hash came back at the previous
# line's values, so neither the wider per-stack blast nor the new pulse ring, bolts, and flash
# bank moves the demos. The visual work cannot: it spawns superpixels, which are not registered
# state. Campaign demos never fire a pulse at all, the perk being Endless-only.
# Regenerated 2026-08-16, for a snapshot-shape change with no simulation change behind it:
# a Chain Reaction pulse now carries whether its owner's Opening Salvo window was running when
# it was struck, so the wave keeps that bump for every hop it goes on to make, and the queue
# gained a parallel tag array (t2.chainPulseSalvo) that the registry has to restore with the
# pulses it belongs to. Verified by building with that single rollback_register line removed,
# every other edit in the commit kept: all three hashes and the layout hash came back at the
# previous line's values, so neither the salvo bump, the raised per-stack damage, nor the move
# from the enemy-health ramp to the owner's damage scale moves the demos. None of them can:
# the perk is Endless-only and the shipped demos never fire a pulse.
# Regenerated 2026-08-16, for a snapshot-shape change with no simulation change behind it:
# flareOwnsFilter now decides which full-screen grade a flare special may pulse and release, so
# it joined the registry (vz.flareOwnsFilter, one byte). Verified by building with that single
# rollback_register line removed, every other edit in the commit kept: all three hashes and the
# layout hash came back at the previous line's values, so the ownership gate itself moves none
# of the demos. Only a flare running out over a live level grade could, and none of the shipped
# demos does that.
